Any of the Gospels (Matthew, Mark, Luke, or John) would be an appropriate place to start. The first three are somewhat similar and are called the "synoptic" Gospels. Mark's is the shortest, most concise, and most "action-packed" account and is sometimes therefore a good first read. Luke's account is the longest and most detailed of all four, and has some amazing parables that are absent from the others. It is maybe my "favorite". Matthew's is probably the most "well-rounded", and also contains the full "Sermon on the Mount" starting in chapter 5. John's is very different than the other three, in that it focuses a LOT on the love of God and is also (Like Mark's) a wonderful place to start. Most people seem to recommend starting in the Book of John!
